An Apollo astronaut faces off against a leading moon landing skeptic in this Danny Jones episode, billed as a debate of the century. The astronaut defends the missions he flew in, while the skeptic presses the classic claims of a hoax. Jones referees one small step, argued at length.

The skeptic raises radiation, photos, and flags, and the astronaut answers from firsthand experience. The exchange stays heated as each man claims the evidence for his side. Jones keeps the floor fair and the questions direct. Debating and star-gazing listeners get the rare sight of the argument held face to face.
